cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The magazine sent your poem back because it's too large a voice for one page. I taught you to stop being timid, and look at you now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They said it wasn't suitable. If you think it's bad too, I'll stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're finally taking your work seriously. Now take my judgment seriously: they haven't got room for what you're doing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you put that on the cover if I print it myself? With your name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. 'A voice that deserves more space.' Put my name under it; you've learned to make people stand behind their advice.

reason: Make A claim influence over the supposedly oversized voice, then interpret B demand for accountable endorsement as further progress while committing to the protective lie.
